svg.title: A service, a layer, one file that composes the layers, and a test that swaps one
svg.desc: 1. The Mailer interface in packages/core/src/mailer.ts: send(message), which fails with MailerError. Your code asks for Mailer and never sees a layer. 2. MailerLive in apps/web/src/server/mailer.ts implements Mailer by sending through the EMAIL binding. 3. MailerLive is listed in AppLayer, next to DatabaseLayer and AuthLive, in apps/web/src/server/layers.ts. 4. In a test, MailerTest also implements Mailer and keeps messages in an array; layer(MailerTest) provides it instead of MailerLive.
